question: What is the meaning of life cycle costing (lcc) economic in relation to chemical properties?
description: Life Cycle Costing (LCC) is a methodology to estimate the total cost of ownership of a system over its lifetime. In relation to chemical properties, LCC considers the costs associated with the production, maintenance, and disposal of materials with chemical properties, such as manufacturing costs, cleaning costs, and end-of-life costs. This helps in making informed decisions about material selection and design for sustainability.
